name: Testlight
description: Run a Multimeter (.mmt) file with Testlight. Pass paths and flags as YAML inputs; does not check out source.
helpMarkDown: Same parameters as [testlight-action](https://github.com/mshobeyri/testlight-action). Docs: [Run in CI](https://mmt.dev/docs/tasks/run-in-ci)
author: mshobeyri

inputs.name: file
inputs.label: File
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the .mmt file (API, test, or suite), relative to the working directory.

inputs.name: envFile
inputs.label: Environment file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to an environment file (.mmt / .yaml). Maps to --env-file.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.label: Preset
inputs.helpMarkDown: Preset name from the env file. Maps to --preset.

inputs.name: example
inputs.label: Example
inputs.helpMarkDown: Example name or index (for example happy-path or #1).

inputs.name: reportFile
inputs.label: Report file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Output path for the report. Parent folders are created. Maps to --report-file.

inputs.name: out
inputs.label: Result JSON
inputs.helpMarkDown: Write result JSON to this path. Maps to --out.

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: mmt-testlight version
inputs.helpMarkDown: npm dist-tag or X.Y.Z (latest, pre, or a version).

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory to run from. Default: the pipeline workspace (already checked out).

outputVariables.name: result
outputVariables.description: Path to the result JSON file when out is set.

outputVariables.name: report
outputVariables.description: Path to the report file when reportFile is set.

outputVariables.name: exitCode
outputVariables.description: Exit code of the testlight command.
